Perfect! **Qg7+** forces checkmate in 2 moves.

**Coaching Note:**
Look for moving your queen to give check and simultaneously attack a second piece. Here, Qg7+ checks the king on h6, forcing Kh5 (only legal move). Then Qxh7# is checkmate—the queen on h7 cannot be captured or blocked. When your queen and knight both attack the same weak area, coordinated forcing moves often deliver mate.
